data.assumption: I interpreted “share of Chennai orders were cancelled last month” as cancelled Chennai orders divided by all non-test Chennai orders with business dates in August 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS cancelled_order_share
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND c.name = 'Chennai'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
